activerecord: ActiveRecord: the library, and this pack's name
create: ActiveRecord: builds and stores a row
insert: ActiveRecord: adds a row without callbacks
insert_all: ActiveRecord: adds several rows without callbacks
update: ActiveRecord: writes changed attributes to matched rows
update_all: ActiveRecord: writes to every matched row without callbacks
upsert: ActiveRecord: adds or overwrites one row
upsert_all: ActiveRecord: adds or overwrites several rows
destroy: ActiveRecord: removes a row, running callbacks
destroy_all: ActiveRecord: removes every matched row, running callbacks
delete: ActiveRecord: removes a row without callbacks
delete_all: ActiveRecord: removes every matched row without callbacks
